text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Alfred Sant says TV frequency problems not yet overcome. The problems have been blamed by the government for its failure to allocate a frequency to the opposition Nationalist Party.
- Father of three killed in traffic black spot

- Private sector bodies see proposed new tax system as increasing the cost of living. The proposed system, to replace VAT, includes customs, excise duties and a tax on products and services. Although still being finalised, the proposed system has drawn fire because it appears complicated and inflationary.
